definitions.explanation: A school for children aged 6-12, covering grades 1-6 in Japan.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}は{来年|らいねん}{小学校|しょうがっこう}に{入|はい}ります。
examples.english: My child will enter elementary school next year.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}は{家|いえ}から{近|ちか}いです。
examples.english: The elementary school is close to my house.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{先生|せんせい}になりたいです。
examples.english: I want to become an elementary school teacher.

notes: 小学校 is part of Japan's compulsory education (義務教育). Children attend from age 6 to 12 (grades 1-6). 小学生 (しょうがくせい) refers to an elementary school student. Elementary school education in Japan is free and mandatory.
